metric_definitions.accuracy: correct task ends / max(expected tasks, observed unique task starts, task ends)
metric_definitions.answered_completion_p95_s: linear-interpolated p95 of completed status=answered tasks only
metric_definitions.answered_rate: answered task ends / the same task denominator
metric_definitions.condition_statistics: Means and sample SD from run_valid repeats only; invalid runs remain in runs and counts.
metric_definitions.correct_tasks_per_min_makespan: correct task ends / (last task end - first task start) * 60
metric_definitions.failure_rate: error + crash + timeout + unfinished tasks / the same task denominator
metric_definitions.kv_tokens_peak: Runtime slot-token estimate; compare only matching kv_tokens_estimator labels.
metric_definitions.policy_estimate_ms_mean: Mean scheduler wall milliseconds spent on request estimation; missing for logs without this instrumentation.
